|joke=The lore is Lando's promise at the end of ''The Empire Strikes Back'', "Princess, we'll find Han. I promise", and Chewbacca's answer, which the script calls only "Chewie's wail":<ref name="imsdb-esb">[https://imsdb.com/scripts/Star-Wars-The-Empire-Strikes-Back.html Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back script], IMSDb. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260719123444/https://imsdb.com/scripts/Star-Wars-The-Empire-Strikes-Back.html Internet Archive], 19 July 2026.</ref> the card spells it "'Auuuuuug!'" and leaves it untranslated. The picture is the two of them in the cockpit of the ''Millennium Falcon'', and the game text can deploy Han to the same site as Chewie or your Lando. It is part of the running gag of cards that print alien speech and sounds without a translation. See [[Jokes#Alien speech and sounds|Jokes]].
